title: Details I noticed
content: These are random details I’ve noticed in mallworld. Cars can drive themselves. People can drive them too but they’re like teslas and you can have them drive automatic. Sometimes you can “die” in the dreams and be sent back, it’s like a video game, it seems when I “fail” I’m put through the same thing again. This is more recent but the trash system works by going through these clear tubes that we have in place of trash cans. You just put your trash in and it gets sucked down/up not sure which. There’s portals. I’ve been through some a couple times, it seems they take you to different worlds and usually can’t go back once you go through. The dreams seem to be dreams within dreams, usually before I enter mallworld I’m in my house in the dream and then I fall asleep and enter mallworld. There’s a term for this called metadreaming , which I wanna look into more. The vibe of early 2000s/90s/80s. This is not a subtle thing but I wish I could emphasize how specific the feeling of these dreams taking place in the early 2000s are. I literally feel like I’m stuck in the past, in my childhood. It seems the malls stuck in that time in some parts, but other parts are super futuristic, theres almost no in between of the 2010s and present styles. There’s people I’ve never seen irl that I’ve seen in mallworld. I don’t know how that’s possible because they say you can’t dream of people you’ve never seen. These people usually give bad vibes and don’t seem to have good intent. I’ll add more later
